comparison.objective: Hold a washed part over its bath to drain before moving it to a rack; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Timed holding and contamination-aware transport versus tool alignment, collar tuning, locking, and repeated dynamic observation.
comparison.success_condition: At least three seconds stationary above the bath before transfer versus two dynamically acceptable stops. No separate specs or drain/spill thresholds are provided.
comparison.reason: The core constraint is dwell-before-transport, not mechanical adjustment.
